issues.description: The subtype and sentence test subject-verb agreement across an intervening of-phrase, which the authoritative taxonomy classifies under CLAUSE_STRUCTURE, not REFERENCE_AND_DETERMINERS.

revision_requirements: Change primary_target to CLAUSE_STRUCTURE; retain the supported subject-verb agreement subtype and agreement_error classification.

issues.description: The error is a gerund/nonfinite-form selection after the preposition in 'concentrated on depicting', which the taxonomy routes to NONFINITE_VERB_PHRASES; VERB_COMPLEMENTATION is not the appropriate primary target for this form-selection item.

revision_requirements: Change primary_target from VERB_COMPLEMENTATION to NONFINITE_VERB_PHRASES; retain the gerund-form subtype and the valid C answer unless any dependent metadata is regenerated.

issues.description: The sentence tests an adjective-versus-adverb form in the noun phrase 'ritually practices', so primary_target should be WORD_CLASS_FORM; PARALLEL_STRUCTURE is contextual and may remain a secondary feature.

revision_requirements: Relabel primary_target from PARALLEL_STRUCTURE to WORD_CLASS_FORM; retain the D error, sentence, marked spans, and correction.

The error is a past-participle form selection after the perfect passive auxiliary sequence 'had been'; the authoritative taxonomy routes participle-form selection to NONFINITE_VERB_PHRASES, not VERB_FORM_VOICE, which is reserved for finite main-verb tense/aspect/voice selection.

revision_requirements: Change primary_target from VERB_FORM_VOICE to NONFINITE_VERB_PHRASES; retain the D error, sentence, marked spans, correction, and wrong_verb_form classification.
